whatIsIt.eli5: Two looking windows, one big and one small, that are merged into one after learning.
whatIsIt.simple: A 7×7 and a 3×3 depthwise convolution run in parallel and are added; after training they are merged into a single 7×7 kernel.
whatIsIt.engineer: act(BN(DW7×7(x)) + BN(DW3×3(x))); fused to one DW7×7 with bias.

whyExists.eli5: The big window sees far; the small one helps learning.
whyExists.simple: A large kernel gives a wide view cheaply; the extra 3×3 branch helps training and costs nothing after merging.
whyExists.engineer: Structural re-parameterisation of large-kernel DW convs.

eli5: Look with a big window and a small window.
engineer: Fusion pads the 3×3 kernel to 7×7 and adds kernels and biases.
